answer: To resist sybil attacks, consensus aggregates equivocation evidence across bonded identities: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting messages, pairwise fault exposure produces penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). Upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss applies as escrow haircuts compound with swarm size, so splitting control among identities named wander, basalt, or meadow does not reduce shared liability.
